extracted.intended_audience: EPO examiners, patent attorneys, applicants and other practitioners concerned with European patent prosecution
extracted.subtask_description: Official EPO Guidelines covering formalities, search, substantive examination, opposition/limitation procedures, procedural matters, application content, patentability and amendments for European patent applications and patents. Intended to be used by examiners and practitioners to assess compliance and quality at each stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preliminary remarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Introductory material and scope of the Guidelines for Examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets out purpose, legal basis and how to use the Guidelines; full explanatory guidance appears in the main text of the Guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explanatory notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Notes explaining the structure, conventions and interpretative approach used in the Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains terminology, references to the EPC and practice notes; consult main text for examples and cross-references.

rubrics_metrics.name: General remarks
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level principles and general approaches applicable across examination, search and opposition procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains overarching standards (e.g. legal interpretation, burden of proof, consistency); detailed application given in specific chapters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work at the EPO
rubrics_metrics.description: Organisation of work, roles and responsibilities within the EPO relevant to examination and search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes who performs which tasks and internal procedures; see chapters on work within examining division for practical rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Survey of the processing of applications and patents at the EPO
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of the stages and flow of a European patent application from filing to grant and post‑grant procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maps procedural stages and their deadlines; consult individual chapters for stage‑specific requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contracting States to the EPC
rubrics_metrics.description: List and implications of EPC Contracting States for filing, validation and territorial effects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains territorial scope and state‑specific considerations; see national validation guidance where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension to and validation in states not party to the EPC
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and conditions for extension/validation of European patents in non‑EPC countries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets out how to obtain effect in states outside EPC; practical steps are in full text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of applications and examination on filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures when filing a European patent application and what is checked at filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers formal filing requirements, filing date attribution, required documents and immediate formal checks; see Filing chapter for particulars.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of formal requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedures for examining compliance with formalities (documents, signatures, representation, forms, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists what is examined at formalities stage and how deficiencies are communicated; specific rules in Part A.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Special rules that apply in particular situations (e.g. national particulars, temporary derogations, exceptions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes atypical cases and how standard procedures are adapted; see chapter text for examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications concerning formal deficiencies; amendment of application; correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: How the EPO communicates formal defects, how applicants may amend applications and the rules for correcting errors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes procedures for inviting amendments, time limits, correction under Rule 139 EPC, and examples of acceptable corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of application; request for examination and transmission of the dossier to examining division
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and timing for publication of the application, filing a request for substantive examination and dossier transmission procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains deadlines for requesting examination, how the file is transmitted and publication consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Language requirements for European patent procedures, translation obligations and language of proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies which languages are accepted, consequences of non‑compliance, translation requirements and derogations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Common provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions that apply generally across multiple formalities and procedural chapters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers recurring rules such as deadlines, notifications and service; see individual chapters for application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal and substantive requirements for drawings submitted with a European patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes format, scale, labelling, amendments to drawings and how to examine drawing compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee rules including payment, refunds, missed payments and consequences of non‑payment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details types of fees (filing, search, examination, renewal), time limits and surcharge procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspection of files; communication of information contained in files; consultation of the European Patent Register; issuance of certified copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Rights and procedures for inspecting patent files, accessing the Register and obtaining certified copies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets out who may inspect, redaction rules, data access methods and fees for certified copies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to search (Part B)
rubrics_metrics.description: Scope and objectives of the EPO search and the role of search in the patent granting process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains differences between search and substantive examination; see Part B chapters for detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: General (search)
rubrics_metrics.description: General principles governing the EPO search practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers legal standards applied in search, limits of search, and examiner duties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characteristics of the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Qualitative standards and expected characteristics of a proper EPO search (completeness, relevance, documentation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes what a good search should achieve and quality metrics used by examiners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search procedure and strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical method and strategic approach examiners must follow when performing a search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes classification, keyword selection, citation of documents and handling of complex inventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preclassification, IPC and CPC classification of European patent applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and practice for classifying applications using IPC/CPC and preclassification procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains when and how classification is assigned and its impact on search and examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: The state of the art at the search stage
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and determination of the relevant prior art for search purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies what documents constitute state of the art at search, temporal and territorial considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (search stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of whether the application concerns one invention or several for search purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets criteria for grouping claims for search, filing of divisional applications and partial searches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject‑matter to be excluded from the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Types of subject‑matter that the EPO will not search (e.g. non‑technical matter, excluded fields).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists exclusions and how to identify non‑searchable subject‑matter; see chapter for examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: What documentation must be created for the search (e.g. citations, search report entries) and how it is recorded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies contents of the search file and formal composition of search reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search report
rubrics_metrics.description: Content and format requirements for the EPO search report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how documents are cited, classifications used, and deficiencies to be noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: The search opinion
rubrics_metrics.description: The EPO's evaluative opinion issued with or after the search indicating patentability prospects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes purpose, content and legal effect (non‑binding) of the search opinion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal requirements to be met before the division starts substantive examination
rubrics_metrics.description: List of formal prerequisites that must be satisfied prior to starting substantive examination (e.g. fees paid, translations filed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies checks and corrective actions required before substantive examination begins.

rubrics_metrics.name: The first stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Initial substantive assessment steps taken by the examining division.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers first communications, how claims are interpreted and preliminary objections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of replies and further stages of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: How the examining division treats applicant replies and the iterative examination process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details admissibility of late submissions, treatment of amendments, and second/third examination steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: The final stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and criteria applied at the final step before decision to grant or refuse.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes finalisation of claim text, checking conformity with formal requirements, and grant formalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annex — Standard marks for indicating amendments or corrections by the divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard notation/markup conventions used by EPO divisions when indicating amendments or corrections in documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the marks and their interpretation; useful for preparing compliant amended texts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits and acceleration of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on statutory and procedural time limits and mechanisms for accelerated processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers request-for-acceleration procedures, GPP, PACE program and consequences of missed time limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other procedures in examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous procedural matters encountered during substantive examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers referral to Enlarged Board, exceptional measures and practice points.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work within the examining division
rubrics_metrics.description: Organisation, internal coordination and division-level rules for conducting examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes division workflows, decision making and allocation of work among examiners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for specific types of applications (e.g. plant/biotech, pharmaceutical, SPC-related, priority disputes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details tailored procedures for particular technical or legal categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: The opposition division
rubrics_metrics.description: Organisation and role of the Opposition Division in post‑grant proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains composition, duties and decision‑making rules for oppositions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive rules governing filing, admissibility and conduct of oppositions to granted European patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers grounds for opposition, filing time limits, evidence rules and procedural steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure up to substantive examination (opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Steps and checks before substantive evaluation of oppositions begins (admissibility, initial formalities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes communication with parties, preliminary legal issues and case management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantive examination of opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and approach to evaluating the substantive grounds of opposition (novelty, inventive step, added matter, sufficiency).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mirrors substantive criteria in Part G and Part H with opposition‑specific application and burden of proof considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for the examination of the opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: How the opposition division conducts the substantive procedural examination including evidentiary steps and oral proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies timelines, exchange of observations and possible outcomes (maintenance, amendment, revocation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions of the opposition division
rubrics_metrics.description: Form, content and legal effect of opposition division decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes reasoning requirements, operative part and possible orders (revocation, maintenance in amended form).

rubrics_metrics.name: Costs (opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on apportionment and awarding of costs in opposition proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains which costs can be recovered, and principles applied by opposition division.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation and revocation procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for centrally limiting or revoking a European patent (including requests under Article 105a/84? — see text).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes how requests are filed, grounds considered and effects of limitation decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications and notifications (procedural matters)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on formal communications and notifications between the EPO and parties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers electronic service, postal rules, deemed receipt and correction of defective notifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Conduct and rules for oral proceedings before EPO divisions (examining, opposition, boards).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes notice requirements, representation, confidentiality, public access and procedural conduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Taking and conservation of evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for admitting, taking and preserving evidence in EPO proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses admissibility, burden of proof, expert evidence and documentary evidence handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Derogations from the language of the proceedings in oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and procedures allowing departures from the established language of proceedings during oral hearings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies conditions under which different languages or interpreters may be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination by the EPO of its own motion; facts, evidence or grounds not submitted in due time; observations by third parties
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for EPO‑initiated examination of issues, late submissions, and third‑party observations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains when EPO may raise issues ex officio, treatment of late evidence and third‑party observation effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interruption, stay and consolidation of the proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: When and how proceedings may be stayed, interrupted or consolidated with other proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers national court stays, requests for consolidation and effects on timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits, loss of rights, further and accelerated processing and reestablishment of rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive rules on time limits, consequences of missing them, options for accelerated processing and reestablishment (restitutio in integrum).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives grounds and procedures for reestablishment and for requesting acceleration; see chapters for deadlines and documentary proof.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)
rubrics_metrics.description: How PCT applications enter the European phase and associated EPO procedures and requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details entry timelines, required translations, and effect of PCT search/opinion on EPO processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions (procedural)
rubrics_metrics.description: General rules on the form, content, and notification of EPO decisions across procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies essential elements of a decision and how decisions are communicated and can be challenged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impartiality of the examining or opposition division
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards ensuring impartiality and absence of bias in decision making by EPO divisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets recusal rules, conflict of interest procedures and how impartiality concerns are handled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing appeal procedures from EPO decisions, including admissibility and procedure before Boards of Appeal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers filing, grounds for appeal, time limits and possible remedies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request from a national court for a technical opinion concerning a European patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure for responding to national court requests for a technical opinion by the EPO regarding a European patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets scope, confidentiality and limits of EPO technical opinions to courts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration of changes of name, transfers, licences and other rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and formal requirements for registering changes in proprietorship, licenses and other rights in the European Patent Register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains evidence required for transfer, recording licenses and effects on the Register.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content of a European patent application (other than claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive and formal requirements for the description, abstract, drawings and other parts of the application (excluding claims).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes required content for disclosure, enabling disclosure standards and abstract checklist references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Checklist for considering the abstract (see F‑II, 2.5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria for drafting and evaluating the abstract of a European patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a checklist for concise and informative abstracts; see annex for detailed items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Units recognised in international practice and complying with Rule 49(10) (see F‑II, 4.13)
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepted units of measurement and formats that comply with EPC Rule 49(10).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists recognized units and formatting conventions for numeric data in applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sufficiency of disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that the disclosure enable a person skilled in the art to carry out the invention (Art.83 EPC standards applied).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how to assess sufficiency, examples of deficiencies and remedial amendment practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims (Art.84 and formal requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for claims clarity, support by the description, and formal requirements under Article 84 EPC and related rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers claim structure, dependency, clarity objections, and examples of compliant/ non‑compliant claim wording.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annex — Examples concerning essential features
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrative examples to determine essential features of claims and their identification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides worked examples to assist examiners and applicants in identifying essential features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (application content / grant stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of unity in the context of the application content and entitlement to one patent (Part F V).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets criteria for unity at grant stage and relationship with search unity findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing priority claims, priority dates, right to priority and proof required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains what qualifies for priority, partial priority issues and documentary evidence needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patentability (Part G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles and statutory requirements determining whether subject‑matter is patentable under the EPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines patentable subject‑matter and key exclusions; detailed tests appear in following chapters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and scope of what constitutes an 'invention' for patentability purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies technical character requirements and borderline cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial application
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that the invention be susceptible of industrial application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how to assess practical applicability and gives examples of acceptable disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: State of the art
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and identification of the prior art relevant for assessing novelty and inventive step.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies which documents and public disclosures form the state of the art.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non‑prejudicial disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances under which certain disclosures do not prejudice novelty or inventive step (e.g. evident grace periods, exhibitions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists exceptions and conditions for non‑prejudicial treatment of disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria for assessing whether claimed subject‑matter is new over the state of the art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes direct anticipation tests and examples; guidance on multiple claim formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive Step
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and approach for assessing inventive step (non‑obviousness) including problem‑solution approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes step‑by‑step methodology, indicators and annex examples illustrating inventive step evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annex — Examples relating to the requirement of inventive step – indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Worked examples and practical indicators to aid assessment of inventive step.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides sample analyses following the problem‑solution approach and common pitfalls.

rubrics_metrics.name: The right to amend
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal and procedural limits on an applicant's or proprietor's ability to amend application or patent documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers timing, scope and constraints of amendment rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admissibility of amendments – general rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria determining when amendments are admissible during prosecution or opposition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains added matter, scope extension prohibitions and procedural admissibility tests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admissibility of amendments – other procedural matters
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural rules affecting admissibility such as timing, format and consequences of amendments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes practical considerations and examples for handling amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of amendments – Art. 123(2) and (3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules assessing whether amendments add subject‑matter (Art.123(2)) or extend scope post‑grant (Art.123(3)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets tests for added matter and prohibits extension of protection; examples provided in full text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of amendments – examples
rubrics_metrics.description: Concrete examples illustrating allowable and non‑allowable amendments under Art.123.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Worked examples to guide examiners and applicants on borderline cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for correction of errors in applications and patents (e.g. Rule 139 EPC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes what constitutes a correctable error, the required evidence and procedure to correct.
